subject: Whistic: Evidence upload plan + CAIQ mapping questions
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-health.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Whistic access + initial evidence list

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the quick intro on Monday. We need to finish vendor validation for Redwood to progress an internal procurement approval. Can you confirm whether you'll:

- Upload SOC 2 Type II and supporting evidence to our Whistic profile;
- Fill the CAIQ mappings for network and data protection controls; and
- Provide an expected date for completion (we'd like this by end of month if possible).

I attached the fields our procurement team will review. Also note our security intake would like a short network diagram and the SOC 2 PDF.

Thanks,
Jordan
Security Engineer, Acme Health
Attachment: acme_acct_evidence_fields.xlsx (XLSX)

From: rachel.kim@redwood.ai
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-health.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Whistic access + initial evidence list

Jordan — thanks for the checklist. Short answers up front: yes, we will upload the SOC 2 Type II and the network diagram to Whistic, and we'll populate CAIQ mappings as part of the upload.

Neha (security) and Priyom (compliance ops) are looped to coordinate the artifact prep and the Whistic upload window. Neha — can you confirm which artifacts we already have ready and which we need to assemble (evidence CSV below)? Priyom — can you schedule a 30-min window for the live upload if Acme prefers we do it with them on the call?

Proposed target: evidence uploaded & CAIQ mapping completed by Apr 28th. If we need an exception, we'll flag it immediately.

-Rachel
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Attachment: proposed_upload_plan.md (TXT)

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: rachel.kim@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Whistic access + initial evidence list

Thanks — quick inventory:
- Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf — ready to upload (controls mapped in internal tracker).
- network_diagram_v2.png — needs a small update (legend + datacenter region tag).
- access_control_policies.docx — public copy exists, need versioned PDF for Whistic.
- whistic_upload_manifest.csv — I'll generate the CSV with filenames + CAIQ control IDs.

Two clarifying Qs for Acme (Jordan):
1) For CAIQ mappings, do you want our responses in the Whistic "Control Responses" fields or as an attached CAIQ spreadsheet? We can do either, but the former makes your review easier.
2) Will you grant our upload user (vendor@redwood-inference.whst) permission to add artifacts directly? If not, we can upload during a screenshare.

I estimate the small doc touch-ups + manifest by Apr 24, then upload during Apr 27–28 window.

—Neha
Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment: planned_manifest_template.csv (CSV)

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-health.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 14:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Whistic access + initial evidence list

Neha — thanks for the clear list. Prefer control responses directly in Whistic (saves us time). I've gone ahead and added vendor@redwood-inference.whst with "Uploader" rights on the profile; you should see an invite email. If there are permissions issues, PM me and we'll adjust.

Also: for CAIQ items around key management, can you attach your KMS provider statement (redacted) alongside the SOC report? A short note in the Whistic control response indicating whether keys are customer-managed or Redwood-managed is helpful.

We confirm the Apr 27–28 upload window works; we'll assign a reviewer to be available on Apr 28 at 10:00 AM PT if you want a live walkthrough.

Jordan
Security Engineer, Acme Health

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-health.com>
Cc: rachel_kim@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Whistic access + initial evidence list

Jordan — quick wrap. We completed the Whistic upload this morning (Apr 28 09:42 AM PT):
- Uploaded: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf, network_diagram_v2.png (legend updated), access_control_policies_v2.pdf
- CAIQ control responses populated directly in Whistic; manifest attached as whistic_upload_manifest.csv.
- Notes added for KMS: "Keys are customer-managed when using Dedicated instances; hosted API uses customer KMS integration via external HSM per tenant."

Links: https://app.whistic.com/profile/redwood-inference (profile view)
Drive artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwoodEvidence
HubSpot ticket: DF-8421

If you want a short screenshare to walk through the mappings, we're free Apr 29 09:00 AM PT. Otherwise let us know if anything requires rework.

Thanks — Priyom
Compliance Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachment: whistic_upload_manifest.csv (CSV); Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf (PDF); network_diagram_v2.png (PNG)
